legend: The map of Bertown can be represented as a set of n$$$n$$$ intersections, numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$ and connected by m$$$m$$$ one-way roads. It is possible to move along the roads from any intersection to any other intersection. The length of some path from one intersection to another is the number of roads that one has to traverse along the path. The shortest path from one intersection v$$$v$$$ to another intersection u$$$u$$$ is the path that starts in v$$$v$$$, ends in u$$$u$$$ and has the minimum length among all such paths.

Polycarp lives near the intersection s$$$s$$$ and works in a building near the intersection t$$$t$$$. Every day he gets from s$$$s$$$ to t$$$t$$$ by car. Today he has chosen the following path to his workplace: p1$$$p_1$$$, p2$$$p_2$$$, ..., pk$$$p_k$$$, where p1=s$$$p_1 = s$$$, pk=t$$$p_k = t$$$, and all other elements of this sequence are the intermediate intersections, listed in the order Polycarp arrived at them. Polycarp never arrived at the same intersection twice, so all elements of this sequence are pairwise distinct. Note that you know Polycarp's path beforehand (it is fixed), and it is not necessarily one of the shortest paths from s$$$s$$$ to t$$$t$$$.

Polycarp's car has a complex navigation system installed in it. Let's describe how it works. When Polycarp starts his journey at the intersection s$$$s$$$, the system chooses some shortest path from s$$$s$$$ to t$$$t$$$ and shows it to Polycarp. Let's denote the next intersection in the chosen path as v$$$v$$$. If Polycarp chooses to drive along the road from s$$$s$$$ to v$$$v$$$, then the navigator shows him the same shortest path (obviously, starting from v$$$v$$$ as soon as he arrives at this intersection). However, if Polycarp chooses to drive to another intersection w$$$w$$$ instead, the navigator rebuilds the path: as soon as Polycarp arrives at w$$$w$$$, the navigation system chooses some shortest path from w$$$w$$$ to t$$$t$$$ and shows it to Polycarp. The same process continues until Polycarp arrives at t$$$t$$$: if Polycarp moves along the road recommended by the system, it maintains the shortest path it has already built; but if Polycarp chooses some other path, the system rebuilds the path by the same rules.
Here is an example. Suppose the map of Bertown looks as follows, and Polycarp drives along the path [1,2,3,4]$$$[1, 2, 3, 4]$$$ (s=1$$$s = 1$$$, t=4$$$t = 4$$$):
Check the picture by the link http://tk.codeforces.com/a.png
When Polycarp starts at 1$$$1$$$, the system chooses some shortest path from 1$$$1$$$ to 4$$$4$$$. There is only one such path, it is [1,5,4]$$$[1, 5, 4]$$$;

Polycarp chooses to drive to 2$$$2$$$, which is not along the path chosen by the system. When Polycarp arrives at 2$$$2$$$, the navigator rebuilds the path by choosing some shortest path from 2$$$2$$$ to 4$$$4$$$, for example, [2,6,4]$$$[2, 6, 4]$$$ (note that it could choose [2,3,4]$$$[2, 3, 4]$$$);

Polycarp chooses to drive to 3$$$3$$$, which is not along the path chosen by the system. When Polycarp arrives at 3$$$3$$$, the navigator rebuilds the path by choosing the only shortest path from 3$$$3$$$ to 4$$$4$$$, which is [3,4]$$$[3, 4]$$$;
Polycarp arrives at 4$$$4$$$ along the road chosen by the navigator, so the system does not have to rebuild anything.

Overall, we get 2$$$2$$$ rebuilds in this scenario. Note that if the system chose [2,3,4]$$$[2, 3, 4]$$$ instead of [2,6,4]$$$[2, 6, 4]$$$ during the second step, there would be only 1$$$1$$$ rebuild (since Polycarp goes along the path, so the system maintains the path [3,4]$$$[3, 4]$$$ during the third step).

The example shows us that the number of rebuilds can differ even if the map of Bertown and the path chosen by Polycarp stays the same. Given this information (the map and Polycarp's path), can you determine the minimum and the maximum number of rebuilds that could have happened during the journey?
input: The first line contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and m$$$m$$$ (2≤n≤m≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n \le m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of intersections and one-way roads in Bertown, respectively.

Then m$$$m$$$ lines follow, each describing a road. Each line contains two integers u$$$u$$$ and v$$$v$$$ (1≤u,v≤n$$$1 \le u, v \le n$$$, u≠v$$$u \ne v$$$) denoting a road from intersection u$$$u$$$ to intersection v$$$v$$$. All roads in Bertown are pairwise distinct, which means that each ordered pair (u,v)$$$(u, v)$$$ appears at most once in these m$$$m$$$ lines (but if there is a road (u,v)$$$(u, v)$$$, the road (v,u)$$$(v, u)$$$ can also appear).
The following line contains one integer k$$$k$$$ (2≤k≤n$$$2 \le k \le n$$$) — the number of intersections in Polycarp's path from home to his workplace.

The last line contains k$$$k$$$ integers p1$$$p_1$$$, p2$$$p_2$$$, ..., pk$$$p_k$$$ (1≤pi≤n$$$1 \le p_i \le n$$$, all these integers are pairwise distinct) — the intersections along Polycarp's path in the order he arrived at them. p1$$$p_1$$$ is the intersection where Polycarp lives (s=p1$$$s = p_1$$$), and pk$$$p_k$$$ is the intersection where Polycarp's workplace is situated (t=pk$$$t = p_k$$$). It is guaranteed that for every i∈[1,k−1]$$$i \in [1, k - 1]$$$ the road from pi$$$p_i$$$ to pi+1$$$p_{i + 1}$$$ exists, so the path goes along the roads of Bertown.
output: Print two integers: the minimum and the maximum number of rebuilds that could have happened during the journey.

legend.ai: Bertown 的地图可以表示为由 n$$$n$$$ 个路口组成的集合，这些路口编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$，并由 m$$$m$$$ 条单向道路连接。沿着道路可以从任意一个路口到达任意另一个路口。从一个路口到另一个路口的某条路径的长度，是沿该路径需要经过的道路数量。从一个路口 v$$$v$$$ 到另一个路口 u$$$u$$$ 的最短路径，是一条从 v$$$v$$$ 出发、在 u$$$u$$$ 结束，并且在所有此类路径中长度最小的路径。

Polycarp 住在路口 s$$$s$$$ 附近，并在路口 t$$$t$$$ 附近的一栋楼里工作。他每天开车从 s$$$s$$$ 前往 t$$$t$$$。今天他选择了如下路线前往工作地点：p1$$$p_1$$$, p2$$$p_2$$$, ..., pk$$$p_k$$$，其中 p1=s$$$p_1 = s$$$，pk=t$$$p_k = t$$$，序列中的其他所有元素都是中间路口，按照 Polycarp 到达它们的顺序列出。Polycarp 从未两次到达同一个路口，因此该序列中的所有元素都两两不同。注意，你事先知道 Polycarp 的路线(它是固定的)，并且它不一定是从 s$$$s$$$ 到 t$$$t$$$ 的最短路径之一。

Polycarp 的汽车中安装了一个复杂的导航系统。下面介绍它的工作方式。当 Polycarp 在路口 s$$$s$$$ 开始行程时，系统会选择一条从 s$$$s$$$ 到 t$$$t$$$ 的最短路径并将其显示给 Polycarp。设所选路径中的下一个路口为 v$$$v$$$。如果 Polycarp 选择沿着从 s$$$s$$$ 到 v$$$v$$$ 的道路行驶，那么导航器会向他显示同一条最短路径(显然，在他到达该路口后，路径从 v$$$v$$$ 开始)。但是，如果 Polycarp 选择前往另一个路口 w$$$w$$$，导航器就会重新规划路径：Polycarp 一到达 w$$$w$$$，导航系统就会选择一条从 w$$$w$$$ 到 t$$$t$$$ 的最短路径并将其显示给他。这个过程会一直持续，直到 Polycarp 到达 t$$$t$$$：如果 Polycarp 沿着系统推荐的道路行驶，系统就会保留已经规划好的最短路径；但如果 Polycarp 选择了其他道路，系统就会按照相同的规则重新规划路径。
下面给出一个例子。假设 Bertown 的地图如下所示，并且 Polycarp 沿着路径 [1,2,3,4]$$$[1, 2, 3, 4]$$$ 行驶(s=1$$$s = 1$$$，t=4$$$t = 4$$$)：
请通过链接 http://tk.codeforces.com/a.png 查看图片
当 Polycarp 从 1$$$1$$$ 出发时，系统会选择一条从 1$$$1$$$ 到 4$$$4$$$ 的最短路径。这样的路径只有一条，即 [1,5,4]$$$[1, 5, 4]$$$；
Polycarp 选择驾车前往 2$$$2$$$，这不在系统所选的路径上。当 Polycarp 到达 2$$$2$$$ 时，导航器通过选择一条从 2$$$2$$$ 到 4$$$4$$$ 的最短路径来重建路径，例如 [2,6,4]$$$[2, 6, 4]$$$(注意，它也可能选择 [2,3,4]$$$[2, 3, 4]$$$)；
Polycarp 选择驾车前往 3$$$3$$$，这不在系统所选的路径上。当 Polycarp 到达 3$$$3$$$ 时，导航器通过选择从 3$$$3$$$ 到 4$$$4$$$ 的唯一最短路径来重建路径，该路径为 [3,4]$$$[3, 4]$$$；
Polycarp 沿着导航器选择的道路到达 4$$$4$$$，因此系统无需重建任何内容。
总的来说，在这种情况下我们需要重建 2$$$2$$$ 次。注意，如果系统在第二步选择了 [2,3,4]$$$[2, 3, 4]$$$ 而不是 [2,6,4]$$$[2, 6, 4]$$$，那么只需要重建 1$$$1$$$ 次(因为 Polycarp 会沿着该路径行驶，所以在第三步中系统会保留路径 [3,4]$$$[3, 4]$$$)。
这个例子告诉我们，即使 Bertown 的地图和 Polycarp 选择的路径保持不变，重建次数也可能不同。给定这些信息（地图和 Polycarp 的路径），你能确定这次旅途中可能发生的最少和最多重建次数吗？

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n$$$n$$$ 和 m$$$m$$$(2≤n≤m≤2⋅105$$$2 \le n \le m \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)——分别表示 Bertown 中的路口数量和单向道路数量。

接下来有 m$$$m$$$ 行，每行描述一条道路。每行包含两个整数 u$$$u$$$ 和 v$$$v$$$(1≤u,v≤n$$$1 \le u, v \le n$$$，u≠v$$$u \ne v$$$)，表示一条从路口 u$$$u$$$ 到路口 v$$$v$$$ 的道路。Bertown 中的所有道路两两不同，这意味着每个有序对 (u,v)$$$(u, v)$$$ 在这 m$$$m$$$ 行中最多出现一次(但如果存在道路 (u,v)$$$(u, v)$$$，道路 (v,u)$$$(v, u)$$$ 也可能出现)。
下面一行包含一个整数 k$$$k$$$(2≤k≤n$$$2 \le k \le n$$$)——Polycarp 从家到工作地点的路径上包含的路口数量。

最后一行包含 k$$$k$$$ 个整数 p1$$$p_1$$$、p2$$$p_2$$$、...、pk$$$p_k$$$(1≤pi≤n$$$1 \le p_i \le n$$$，这些整数两两不同)——按照 Polycarp 到达它们的顺序给出其路径上的路口。p1$$$p_1$$$ 是 Polycarp 居住的路口(s=p1$$$s = p_1$$$)，而 pk$$$p_k$$$ 是 Polycarp 工作地点所在的路口(t=pk$$$t = p_k$$$)。保证对于每个 i∈[1,k−1]$$$i \in [1, k - 1]$$$，从 pi$$$p_i$$$ 到 pi+1$$$p_{i + 1}$$$ 的道路都存在，因此这条路径沿着 Bertown 的道路行进。

output.ai: 输出两个整数：旅途中可能发生的重建次数的最小值和最大值。
